methodology.clock: process.hrtime.bigint monotonic nanoseconds normalized per operation.
methodology.warmup: Ten full randomized warmup batches per operation before timed sampling.
methodology.sampling: Thirty-one raw samples per operation; Node N-API uses thirty-one fresh child processes and resources use seven GC-isolated child processes.
methodology.interleaving: A deterministic seeded permutation interleaves operation batches to reduce fixed-order cache and scheduler bias.
methodology.estimator: Nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 over 31 samples; p95 is the 30th ordered sample, not the maximum.
methodology.confidence: Dirty-machine local characterization only. No numeric release budget freezes until repeated clean-environment capture series are retained.
methodology.isolation: Resource and Node N-API probes use fresh child processes; IPC uses a dedicated advanced-serialization child process.
methodology.scope: No RN binary bridge, zero-copy claim, Electron ABI/renderer IPC, physical radio, or package-release proof.
